name: gtg
description: Pause/resume workflow for Claude Code sessions.

scripts._test-note: A GLOB, not a hand-listed set of legs. The list version silently skipped a whole suite once: Task 1's 15 store cases were written, committed and never run because nobody remembered to add them here. `node --test <dir>` picks up every *.test.mjs, so a new suite runs the day it lands. The assert-based suites (gtg, issues) run under it too - a plain script that throws exits non-zero and the runner reports it as a failed file.
